Name: Mesh
Description: Specifies the 3D mesh file to import. The mesh will be converted and rendered as a heightfield for use in terrain generation.

Name: Relative Path
Description: Defines the file path to the mesh relative to the project or asset directory. Ensures portability and correct asset referencing.

Name: Position
Description: Automatically positions the object so its lowest point rests on the terrain base, preventing it from floating or being embedded below the surface.

Name: Drop to Floor
Description: Automatically positions the object so its lowest point rests on the terrain base, preventing it from floating or being embedded below the surface.

Name: Offset X
Description: Shifts the object horizontally along the X axis, allowing precise placement within the terrain.

Name: Offset Y
Description: Shifts the object horizontally along the Y axis, allowing precise placement within the terrain.

Name: Offset Z
Description: Moves the object vertically along the Z axis, raising or lowering it relative to the terrain surface.

Name: Scale
Description: Group containing parameters for scaling the imported object.

Name: Scale
Description: Group containing parameters for scaling the imported object.

Name: Rotation
Description: Rotates the object around the X axis, tilting it forward or backward.

Name: Pitch
Description: Rotates the object around the X axis, tilting it forward or backward.

Name: Yaw
Description: Rotates the object around the Y axis, turning it left or right.

Name: Roll
Description: Rotates the object around the Z axis, spinning it clockwise or counterclockwise.

Name: Quality
Description: Enables or adjusts antialiasing for the heightfield rendering, reducing jagged edges and improving visual smoothness.

Name: Antialiasing
Description: Enables or adjusts antialiasing for the heightfield rendering, reducing jagged edges and improving visual smoothness.
